Welcome to the support page for **gamlss.longitudinal**.

This package fits longitudinal regression models with GAMLSS marginal
distributions and copulas for within-subject dependence.

Use this page as the landing point for the main workflows and support articles.

Version 0.3.1 includes six compact installed vignettes. The detailed
worked example and JSS reviewer tour remain repository and website articles;
they are excluded from the CRAN source tarball. Version 0.3.1 is a maintenance
update; 0.3.0 remains the frozen review reference. Paper results
require their own recorded software and paper revisions, rather than this
version label alone.

Please report bugs or issues at https://github.com/ahibbert/gamlss.longitudinal/issues.

The reported `gamlss.dist` 6.1-11 NBI/ZINBI probability-function and ZISICHEL
density defects remain known dependency limitations; see the
[upstream issue](https://github.com/gamlss-dev/gamlss.dist/issues/14).
They can affect calculations reached through that dependency, including fitting
and inference. Native fast NBI/ZINBI helpers protect some paths, rather than all
consumers. Results using the defective ZISICHEL density remain unqualified.
This maintenance version leaves statistical calculations and the dependency
unchanged; convergence or finite output alone does not validate those results.

The motivating comparison of methods for bivariate correlated data is available
at the link below. The paper describing this package is being prepared and has
no public identifier yet.

- https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.11892

## Start here

Installation:
```
remotes::install_github("ahibbert/gamlss.longitudinal")
```

Worked examples for end-to-end model fits using gamlss.longitudinal.
